article.title: Dissolution of a firm.
article.content: The dissolution of partnership between all the partners of a firm is called the “dissolution of the firm”.
article.html:
39Dissolution of a firm.

Section 39 · Chapter VI · page 10 of the Act

The dissolution of partnership between all the partners of a firm is called the “dissolution of the firm”.
